name: histamine N-methyltransferase

function.text: HNMT is the approved symbol for histamine N-methyltransferase. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in histamine N-methyltransferase activity; histamine catabolic process; histamine metabolic process.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include intellectual developmental disorder, autosomal recessive 51 (autosomal recessive). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Hepatocellular carcinoma; Lung squamous cell carcinoma; Gastric adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; Strong GenCC assertion, Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific review required.

function.text: HNMT encodes histamine N-methyltransferase. Its functions include histamine N-methyltransferase activity and histamine catabolic process.

germline.text: Germline disease associations include intellectual developmental disorder, autosomal recessive 51 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving HNMT have been reported in endometrial carcinoma, gastric adenocarcinoma, and hepatocellular carcinoma.
